# Hook reference

<!-- Generated by `php bin/cms hooks:list --markdown` from Kestello 0.1.0. Edit the code, not this page. -->

Every event and filter Kestello offers to plugins and themes, with the version it appeared in. [Events and filters](/developers/events) explains how to listen to them and the [deprecation policy](/developers/events#compatibility-and-deprecation) says how long a hook keeps working once it is replaced.

Events are in the namespace shown under each name. Filter callbacks receive the value first, then the arguments in the order listed, and return the value.

## Events

### Accounts and sign-in

#### IdentityLinked

`Kestello\Cms\Events\IdentityLinked`, since 0.1.0.

An external sign-in identity (Google, GitHub and so on, from a plugin) was linked to a user.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$provider` | `string` | The sign-in provider, such as `google`. |
| `$identityId` | `int` | The stored identity. |
| `$via` | `string` | `registration` (a new account), `profile` (the user linked it) or `email` (linked at sign-in because the verified email matched an account). |

#### IdentityUnlinked

`Kestello\Cms\Events\IdentityUnlinked`, since 0.1.0.

A user removed an external sign-in identity from their account.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$provider` | `string` | The sign-in provider. |
| `$identityId` | `int` | The identity that was removed. |

#### LoginFailed

`Kestello\Cms\Events\LoginFailed`, since 0.1.0.

A sign-in attempt failed: an unknown account, a wrong password, an inactive account, too many attempts, or a wrong second factor.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$identifier` | `string` | What was typed as the username or email. |
| `$userId` | `?int` | The account, when it exists. |
| `$reason` | `string` | `credentials`, `throttled` or `two_factor`. |
| `$ip` | `string` | The client address. |

#### PasswordChanged

`Kestello\Cms\Events\PasswordChanged`, since 0.1.0.

A user's password changed: by the user, by an admin, or with a reset link. Other sessions and tokens may have been signed out with it.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$via` | `string` | `profile`, `reset` or `admin`. |
| `$sessionsRevoked` | `int` | Sessions signed out. |
| `$tokensRevoked` | `int` | Access tokens revoked. |

#### PasswordResetRequested

`Kestello\Cms\Events\PasswordResetRequested`, since 0.1.0.

A password reset link was sent. Only dispatched when the account exists, so listeners never learn about unknown addresses.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$ip` | `string` | The client address that asked. |

#### SessionRevoked

`Kestello\Cms\Events\SessionRevoked`, since 0.1.0.

One of a user's sessions (devices) was signed out, or all of them except the current one.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$sessionId` | `string` | The hashed session id. With allOthers, the session that was kept. |
| `$allOthers` | `bool` | True when every other session was signed out. |
| `$count` | `int` | How many sessions were signed out. |

#### TokenCreated

`Kestello\Cms\Events\TokenCreated`, since 0.1.0.

A personal access token was created. The token itself is never part of the event.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The owner. |
| `$tokenId` | `int` | The token. |
| `$name` | `string` | The name the owner gave it. |
| `$scopes` | `list<string>` | What it may do, such as `content:read`. |

#### TokenRevoked

`Kestello\Cms\Events\TokenRevoked`, since 0.1.0.

A personal access token was revoked, or all of a user's tokens were.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The owner. |
| `$tokenId` | `?int` | The token, or null when all of them were revoked. |

#### TwoFactorDisabled

`Kestello\Cms\Events\TwoFactorDisabled`, since 0.1.0.

A user's second factor was removed: by the user, or reset with `auth:reset-2fa`.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$byUserId` | `?int` | Who removed it, or null from the command line. |

#### TwoFactorEnabled

`Kestello\Cms\Events\TwoFactorEnabled`, since 0.1.0.

A user finished setting up a second factor.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$type` | `string` | The kind of factor, such as `totp`. |

#### UserLoggedIn

`Kestello\Cms\Events\UserLoggedIn`, since 0.1.0.

Someone signed in.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The user. |
| `$user` | `array<string, mixed>` | The public user fields (never the password or tokens). |
| `$method` | `string` | `password`, or the provider for an external sign-in, followed by `+totp` or `+recovery` when a second factor was used. |

#### UserLoggedOut

`Kestello\Cms\Events\UserLoggedOut`, since 0.1.0.

Someone signed out.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `?int` | The user, or null when the session had already expired. |

#### UserRegistered

`Kestello\Cms\Events\UserRegistered`, since 0.1.0.

A user account was created: by an admin, by email sign-up or by signing in with a provider. Not dispatched for the first admin, who is created by the installer before plugins run.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `int` | The new user. |
| `$via` | `string` | `admin`, `email` for email sign-up, or `external:<provider>` for an account created at sign-in. |

### Background jobs

#### JobFailed

`Kestello\Cms\Events\JobFailed`, since 0.1.0.

A background job used up its attempts, or could not be built, and was moved to the failed jobs list.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$job` | `string` | The job class. |
| `$queue` | `string` | The queue it ran on. |
| `$owner` | `string` | `core`, or the plugin that pushed it, such as `plugin:acme`. |
| `$exception` | `Throwable` | The last error. |

### Content

#### EntryAssigned

`Kestello\Cms\Events\EntryAssigned`, since 0.1.0.

An entry was assigned to someone, or unassigned.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$entryId` | `int` | The entry. |
| `$type` | `string` | Its content type, such as `post`. |
| `$assigneeId` | `?int` | Who it is assigned to now, or null when nobody. |
| `$userId` | `?int` | Who assigned it. |

#### EntryCommented

`Kestello\Cms\Events\EntryCommented`, since 0.1.0.

Someone left an editorial comment on an entry. Comments are only seen in the admin, never on the site.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$entryId` | `int` | The entry. |
| `$type` | `string` | Its content type, such as `post`. |
| `$commentId` | `int` | The comment. |
| `$userId` | `?int` | Who wrote it. |

#### EntryPublished

`Kestello\Cms\Events\EntryPublished`, since 0.1.0.

An entry became visible to visitors: it was published, or a scheduled entry reached its time. It is plain data, so listeners may run in the background with `#[Queued]`.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$entryId` | `int` | The entry. |
| `$type` | `string` | Its content type, such as `post`. |
| `$title` | `string` | Its title. |
| `$path` | `?string` | Its address on the site, or null for a type without public pages. |

#### EntryReviewed

`Kestello\Cms\Events\EntryReviewed`, since 0.1.0.

A reviewer decided on an entry that was in review: they published or scheduled it (`approved`), or sent it back to draft with a note (`changes_requested`). Core notifies whoever submitted it.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$entryId` | `int` | The entry. |
| `$type` | `string` | Its content type, such as `post`. |
| `$title` | `string` | Its title. |
| `$decision` | `string` | `approved` or `changes_requested`. |
| `$reviewerId` | `?int` | Who decided. |
| `$note` | `?string` | What the reviewer asked for, when changes were requested. |

#### EntrySaved

`Kestello\Cms\Events\EntrySaved`, since 0.1.0.

An entry was created or saved through the editor, the API or a plugin using Entries. Fires once per save, after the database is updated; see EntryPublished for the moment it becomes visible.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$entryId` | `int` | The entry. |
| `$type` | `string` | Its content type, such as `post`. |
| `$title` | `string` | Its title. |
| `$status` | `string` | Its status after the save: `draft`, `pending`, `scheduled`, `published` or `private`. |
| `$created` | `bool` | Whether this save created it. |
| `$userId` | `?int` | Who saved it. |

#### EntrySubmitted

`Kestello\Cms\Events\EntrySubmitted`, since 0.1.0.

An entry was submitted for review: its status became `pending`. Core notifies the entry's assignee, or everyone who may publish it.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$entryId` | `int` | The entry. |
| `$type` | `string` | Its content type, such as `post`. |
| `$title` | `string` | Its title. |
| `$userId` | `?int` | Who submitted it. |

#### EntryTrashed

`Kestello\Cms\Events\EntryTrashed`, since 0.1.0.

An entry was moved to the trash. It leaves the site at once, and can be restored until the trash is emptied.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$entryId` | `int` | The entry. |
| `$type` | `string` | Its content type, such as `post`. |
| `$title` | `string` | Its title. |
| `$userId` | `?int` | Who trashed it. |

### Forms

#### FormSubmitted

`Kestello\Cms\Events\FormSubmitted`, since 0.1.0.

Someone sent a form on the site and it passed every check. It is plain data, so listeners (webhooks, a CRM, a newsletter) may run in the background with `#[Queued]`.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$formId` | `int` | The form. |
| `$submissionId` | `?int` | The stored submission, or null when the form does not keep submissions. |
| `$data` | `array<string, mixed>` | Field name => value. Uploaded files are lists of {name, size, type, key}. |

### Models

#### Created

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Created`, since 0.1.0.

After a model was inserted. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Creating

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Creating`, since 0.1.0. Listeners can stop the ones after them.

Before a model is inserted, after saving. A listener may cancel the write. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Deleted

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Deleted`, since 0.1.0.

After a model was deleted. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Deleting

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Deleting`, since 0.1.0. Listeners can stop the ones after them.

Before a model is deleted (soft or for good). A listener may cancel the delete. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Restored

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Restored`, since 0.1.0.

After a soft-deleted model was restored. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Restoring

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Restoring`, since 0.1.0. Listeners can stop the ones after them.

Before a soft-deleted model is restored. A listener may cancel it. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Saved

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Saved`, since 0.1.0.

After a model was inserted or updated, after created or updated. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Saving

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Saving`, since 0.1.0. Listeners can stop the ones after them.

Before a model is inserted or updated. A listener may cancel the write. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Updated

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Updated`, since 0.1.0.

After a model was updated. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

#### Updating

`Kestello\Framework\Database\Orm\Events\Updating`, since 0.1.0. Listeners can stop the ones after them.

Before a model is updated, after saving. A listener may cancel the write. `$event`->model is the model.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$model` | `Model` | The model being written. |

### Notifications

#### NotificationFailed

`Kestello\Cms\Events\NotificationFailed`, since 0.1.0.

A notification could not be delivered on one channel. Other channels are tried anyway.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `?int` | The recipient, or null for an address that is not a user. |
| `$type` | `string` | The notification type, such as `core.health-alert`. |
| `$channel` | `string` | `database`, `mail`, or a channel a plugin added. |
| `$error` | `string` | What went wrong. |

#### NotificationSent

`Kestello\Cms\Events\NotificationSent`, since 0.1.0.

A notification was delivered on one channel.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `?int` | The recipient, or null for an address that is not a user. |
| `$type` | `string` | The notification type. |
| `$channel` | `string` | `database`, `mail`, or a channel a plugin added. |

### System

#### KernelBooted

`Kestello\Cms\Events\KernelBooted`, since 0.1.0.

Every module, plugin and theme has booted. Dispatched once per request or command, before the request is handled.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$console` | `bool` | True for a command, false for a web request. |
| `$recoveryMode` | `bool` | True when plugins are skipped (a recovery link, or `--safe`). |

#### PlatformChanged

`Kestello\Cms\Platform\PlatformChanged`, since 0.1.0.

The settings of a platform service (cache, sessions, queue, search) were changed or reset on the Infrastructure screen, or with `platform:set` or `platform:reset`.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `$subsystem` | `string` | `cache`, `session`, `queue`, `search`, or a service a plugin adds. |
| `$previousDriver` | `string` | The driver before the change. |
| `$driver` | `string` | The driver now. |
| `$changed` | `list<string>` | The names of the options whose value changed. Secrets are named, never included. |
| `$userId` | `?int` | Who changed it. |
| `$reset` | `bool` | True when the screen's settings were removed, back to the configuration file and environment. |

## Filters

### API

#### `api.response.{resource}` {#api-response-resource}

Since 0.1.0. The value is `array`.

The fields of one API resource row (users, entries, media...). Add or redact fields; a result that removes keys is ignored and logged.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `array $row` | The row being shown. |
| `Principal $principal` | Who is asking. |

### Accounts and sign-in

#### `auth.can_register`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `bool`.

Whether someone may create an account, by email sign-up or by signing in with a provider.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `string $email` | The address the account would use. Empty when a provider shared none. |
| `?ExternalIdentity $identity` | Who is signing in with a provider, or null for email sign-up. |

#### `auth.default_role`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `string`.

The role of an account someone creates for themselves. admin and unknown roles become user.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `string $email` | The address the account would use. Empty when a provider shared none. |
| `?ExternalIdentity $identity` | Who is signing in with a provider, or null for email sign-up. |

#### `auth.password.errors`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `list`.

Errors for a new password. Add your own rules; core's errors cannot be removed.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `string $password` | The new password. |
| `?array $user` | The user, when known (username, email). |

#### `auth.redirect_after_login`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `string`.

Where to go after signing in with a provider or finishing email sign-up. The result must stay on this site.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `array $user` | The user who signed in. |

### Backups

#### `backup.skip_tables`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `list`.

Tables to leave out of backups, such as a large log table.

### Media

#### `media.scan`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `?string`.

Check an uploaded file, for example with a virus scanner. Return a message to reject the upload.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `array $file` | filename, mime, size, path, disk and key. |

### Pages

#### `page.body_open`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `string`.

HTML right after `<body>` on public pages.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `array $data` | The page props. |

#### `page.footer`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `string`.

HTML right before `</body>` on public pages.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `array $data` | The page props. |

#### `page.head`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `string`.

HTML added to the `<head>` of public pages. Use the page nonce for inline scripts.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `array $data` | The page props. |

#### `page.icons`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `string`.

The favicon and theme colour tags of every page.

#### `page.shared`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `array`.

The data shared with every Vue page. It is sent to the browser, so never add secrets.

#### `pagecache.query`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `list`.

Query parameters that get their own page cache entry. The default is ['page'].

#### `robots.txt`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `string`.

The generated robots.txt.

#### `seo.head`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `list`.

The search and sharing tags of a page, as ['meta' or 'link', attributes] pairs. Kestello escapes the attributes.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `array $data` | The page props. |

### Security

#### `security.csp`

Since 0.1.0. The value is `array`.

The Content Security Policy, directive name => value. Names are lowercase; values may not contain ; or line breaks.
